title: Chapter 193 Disdain
content:
Chapter 193 Disdain

Immediately, not long after, the various forces made their own decisions.

Some forces chose to wait and see.

Some forces chose to send people to apologize to Huangcheng.

Some forces even directly chose to bow to the deserted city to save their lives.

The decisions are different, but none of the forces chooses to confront the deserted city.

Just kidding, the Lord of Huangcheng instantly killed five powerful people in the Immortal Emperor Realm with one blow, including even the late stage of the Immortal Emperor Realm.

Instant killing is not as simple as suppressing or crushing.

That kind of strength is no longer something they can imagine.

In front of those strong people, they could not even have the slightest idea of resistance.

At this time, Wan Feng, who was in the deserted city, still didn't know that Huangcheng has now completely become the overlord of the Wood Fairy World and has no opponent to speak of.

This goal has not been achieved in several years.

It only took Lu Daosheng less than a quarter of an hour.

"Mr. Wan."

At this time, Xun Heng walked to Wanfeng with a flattering look on his face.

Looking at Xun Heng's villain's virtue, Wan Feng snorted, "Oh, aren't you dead? Why, are you resurrected after watching the advertisement?"

When Xun Heng heard Wan Feng mocking him, he remained calm.

"Master Wan, you are so serious. Our Huangcheng is now in its upsurge. Although Xun has little ability, as a member of Huangcheng, he wants to contribute his slight strength to Huangcheng. How can he die at will?"

"Besides, the city lord has already arrived, so Xun Heng naturally has to come from a family."

Xun Heng said these righteous words, his waist gradually straightened and looked righteous.

And Wan Feng twitched slightly.

"I want to beat you up."

"Well, Lord Wan, I will bow to the deserted city,"

"roll!"

"Okay!"

Seeing that Wan Feng had raised his hard fist, Xun Heng shrank his head and quickly left here as if he was running away.

In place, Wan Feng looked at Xun Heng's departure back and stamped his feet in anger.

What did you do?

He even paid him a million immortal crystals a month. If I had known this guy was so cheap, I should have been bargaining at the beginning.

Xianjing, a common currency in the fairy world.

It can not only be used to purchase various elixirs, magic weapons and other items, but also can be directly absorbed and improved in cultivation.

The average ordinary Immortal Emperor Realm powerhouse only has millions of immortal crystals.

However, Wan Feng lowered his head and touched the ring on his finger. After feeling the remaining tens of billions of immortal crystals inside, he immediately felt that it seemed nothing was wrong.

That was given to her by Lu Daosheng before leaving.

Among them, there are a large number of rare elixirs and some rare fruits.

She was not willing to use those things.

My master really found a powerful man. Not only is he strong, but he is also so rich. No wonder even a person like his master can win it.

Wan Feng thought so, but she didn't know that Yan Lingyun was just the penniless and a little bit second, but she was full of her eyes.

At this time, Xun Heng, who had already run away, suddenly ran back.

Seeing Xun Heng, Wan Feng subconsciously retracted his hand.

"What happened?"

Wanfeng frowned slightly.

Xun Heng noticed the movements of Wanfeng and was a little confused, but he still reported the matter to Wanfeng.

"Master Wan, there are suddenly many strong people coming outside the city. They ask to meet our city lord."

"How many strong people?"

Hearing this, Wan Feng frowned even deeper.

"Follow me to see."

"Yes, sir."

Immediately, the two of them headed towards the outside of the city.

At this time, on the city wall, several guards from the Immortal Saint Realm were staring at the strangers outside the city with a vigilant look on their faces, which looked extremely reliable.

However, they are basically some casual cultivators, and in order to cultivate resources, they chose to recruit into the deserted city as a guard guard.

Among their principles, the most important thing in this job is their own life.

When they encounter danger, they will run away as soon as possible.

After all, no matter how important money is, can it be more important than life?

At this time, Wan Feng and Xun Heng came from the city to the wall.

"I've met Lord Wan."

Wanfeng nodded, then turned around and looked at the people outside the city.

"What's the matter with you, what do you do when you find my city lord?"

With just one glance, Wan Feng recognized the identities of these people, so his tone was very cold.

Outside the city.

The leader took a step forward and showed a very friendly smile.

"Senior Mad Emperor, the leader of Xiayunxiao Sect, came this time to compensate the Lord of Huangcheng. He offended Huangcheng before."

As he said that, the leader of Yunxiao Sect directly presented a ring and handed it to Wanfeng on the city wall from a distance.

"I don't have any respect."

Seeing this, some people from other forces around him immediately cursed in their hearts.

This guy is such a dog.

The leader of the Yunxiao Sect did this so that they had to offer some dedication, otherwise, the lord of Huangcheng would not have seen them.

I guess I can't even pass the level of the Crazy Emperor in front of me.

However, they did not notice Wan Feng's expression at this moment.

Want to laugh.

Two hundred thousand immortal crystals, where are you the beggars?

Bang!

Wan Feng used one hand to force, and the ring that stored 200,000 immortal crystals suddenly shattered and turned into a piece of dust and dispersed in the wind.

At this moment, the scene suddenly became quiet.

Everyone looked at Wan Feng in shock.

"You!"

Below, the leader of Yunxiao Sect was bleeding in his heart when he saw this scene.

Two hundred thousand immortal crystals, that's two hundred thousand immortal crystals! !

He didn't expect that this mad emperor would not even look down on two hundred thousand immortal crystals.

When the others reacted, they were a little happy.

Oh, you deserved it for being so clever.

At this time, Wanfeng said coldly: "You ugly guys, do you deserve to see my city lord?"

Boom!

A special breath surged out of Wanfeng's body. In just a moment, everyone outside the city felt a sense of suffocation that was extremely overbearing.

This guy hid his strength.

This is what they thought in their hearts.

But they didn't know that this was the power that frightened the immortal world back then.

Taboo power!

"Crazy Emperor, I respect the strength of the Lord of Desolate City, but if you say that we are all crooked, aren't you a bit too arrogant!"

"You are not the Lord of Desolate City!"

At this time, a man in the crowd stood up and pointed at Wan Feng with an angry look.

Hearing this, Wan Feng raised his eyebrows slightly and looked at the man.

The Lord of the Immortal Soul Sect.

Wan Feng was very impressed with the Immortal Soul Sect.

Because among the nine immortal emperors who participated in the siege of him, there was the ancestor of the Immortal Soul Sect.

More importantly, the ancestor of the Immortal Soul Sect was very good in that battle.

That battle.

Ten terrifying existences in the realm of immortal emperors took action, causing the void of the Wood Immortal Realm to be shattered.

Nine immortal emperors who have been famous for a long time joined forces to fight against an immortal emperor who has just become famous.

This is rare in the entire history of the immortal world.

And that battle was also quite tragic.

Among the nine immortal emperors, the ancestor of one faction died directly in that battle.

Three were seriously injured.

Four were slightly injured.

The clothes of the ancestor of the Immortal Soul Sect were slightly dirty.

If the Immortal Soul Sect was not the most powerful at the time, the sects behind the other immortal emperors would have almost wanted to attack the Immortal Soul Sect to ask for an explanation.

Is there such a mess?
